nodes.label: Single URL-Encoding Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Every query value is URL-encoded exactly once by the transport; callers must pass raw values and never call urlencode() themselves. Older Agent methods double-encoded (urlencode() then http_build_query()) turning + into %252B; urlEncodeDefault is now a deprecated no-op.

nodes.label: add_lead (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a new lead to the vicidial_list table with several fields and options. Requires API user_level/permission: modify_leads=1. Requires modify_leads=1; checks DNC / campaign DNC and duplicate rules depending on flags; response data carries phone_number|list_id|lead_id.

nodes.label: moh_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs a list of music on hold classes in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 7. Only format=selectframe works; fails if Central Sound Control is not active.

nodes.label: vm_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs a list of voicemail boxes in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 7. Only format=selectframe works; fails if Central Sound Control is not active.

nodes.label: external_add_lead (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a lead in the manual dial list of the campaign for the logged-in agent. A much simplified add_lead compared to the Non-Agent API function; adds to the campaign's manual dial list with optional dnc_check / campaign_dnc_check.

nodes.label: external_dial (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Manually dials a number on the agent's screen. Pauses the agent after the current call, enters the call info and dials on the agent screen; lead_id overrides value when both are set; search=YES looks up an existing lead first.

nodes.label: external_hangup (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Hangs up the current customer call on the agent screen.

nodes.label: external_pause (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Pauses/resumes an agent now, or after their next call if on a call. Pause takes effect after the live call is dispositioned; the official doc orders pause -> hangup -> dispo so the agent does not get a new call between steps.

nodes.label: external_status (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sets the disposition for the current call and moves on to next call.

nodes.label: logout (Agent API)

nodes.label: park_call (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Parks customer or grabs customer from park or ivr.

nodes.label: pause_code (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Set a pause code if the agent is paused. Fails with 'agent is not paused' unless the agent is paused; value max 6 characters.

nodes.label: transfer_conference (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends several commands related to the agent transfer-conf frame.

nodes.label: update_fields (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Changes values for selected data fields in the agent interface. Only fields specified in the call are modified; most special characters are disallowed but single quotes are allowed.

nodes.label: VICIdial has no idempotency keys: retrying add_lead after a timeout can create duplicates
nodes.norm_label: vicidial has no idempotency keys: retrying add_lead after a timeout can create duplicates
nodes.rationale: Default RetryConfig should retry only read-only functions, or the docs must warn loudly.

nodes.label: Double Slash in Request URL Fix
nodes.norm_label: double slash in request url fix

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker Pattern
nodes.rationale: Suggested (not built in) for high-traffic apps: stop calling after a failure threshold and reopen after a cooldown. Listed as a potential v2.1+ enhancement.

nodes.label: Minimum Production Configuration
nodes.rationale: https protocol, timeout 60, connectTimeout 10, RetryConfig::default(), PSR-3 logger; claimed to handle ~95% of production scenarios. Monitor error rate >5%, retry rate >30%, avg duration >10s.

nodes.label: Future Reliability Enhancements (v2.1+)
nodes.rationale: Circuit breaker, built-in request metrics, retry budgets, custom retry predicates, async/promise support, request/response middleware, rate limiting helpers.

nodes.label: Separate Connect and Request Timeouts
nodes.rationale: Connect timeout (default 10s) catches network problems early while the request timeout (default 30s, recommended 60s) allows long operations; VicidialConfig validates connectTimeout <= timeout. Standard practice in production HTTP clients; added after the first production outage caused by hung requests.

nodes.label: Exponential Backoff with Jitter
nodes.rationale: delay = min(initialDelay * multiplier^attempt, maxDelay) + random jitter (0-25%). Progressively longer delays avoid overwhelming a recovering server; jitter prevents thundering-herd when many clients retry at once. Industry standard (AWS SDK, Google APIs). Default: 3 attempts, 1s initial, 10s cap, 2x multiplier.

nodes.label: PSR-3 Logger Integration
nodes.rationale: Accept any PSR-3 logger (psr/log ^3.0) so users plug in existing infrastructure (Monolog etc.); a bundled NullLogger gives zero overhead when no logger is configured. Levels: DEBUG request initiation/retry attempts, INFO success + retry decisions, WARNING HTTP errors, ERROR network errors / retries exhausted; request metrics include duration_ms, status_code, attempt.

nodes.label: Retryable Failure Classification
nodes.rationale: Retried: 5xx (500/502/503/504), 429 rate limiting, network errors (timeout, refused, DNS, TLS). Not retried: 4xx except 429 because those indicate programming errors, not transient conditions. Retries are disabled by default (opt-in via RetryConfig::default()).

nodes.label: Sensitive Parameter Redaction in Logs
nodes.rationale: pass/password, api_key, auth/token, secret are replaced with ***REDACTED*** before logging, automatically, so credentials cannot leak into logs and data-protection requirements are met without developer action.

nodes.label: Vicidial snake_case to Wrapper camelCase Mapping
nodes.norm_label: vicidial snake_case to wrapper camelcase mapping
nodes.rationale: external_dial->dial(), external_hangup->hangup(), external_pause->pause(), pause_code->pauseCode(), external_status->dispo(), update_fields->updateFields(), add_lead->addLead(), moh_list->mohList(), vm_list->vmList(), agent_status->agentStatus(), call_status_stats->callStatusStats().

nodes.label: Consistent Method Prefix Terminology
nodes.rationale: add* creates resources, update* modifies, descriptive nouns retrieve (version(), mohList(), agentStatus()); avoid redundant context prefixes like agentPauseCode() inside agent().

nodes.label: Standard Domain Abbreviations
nodes.rationale: did (Direct Inward Dialing), moh (Music On Hold), vm (Voicemail), ccc (Customer Contact Center), dnc (Do Not Call), fpg (Filter Phone Group), cid (Caller ID).

nodes.label: API Coverage Guard Tests
nodes.rationale: AdminCoverageTest and AgentCoverageTest fail when a function documented by Vicidial has no wrapper method, so parity cannot silently regress; RecordingTransporter asserts the exact URL/query a method produces.

nodes.label: camelCase Method Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: All public methods are camelCase (PHP standard) so IDE autocomplete works and names are predictable; no snake_case in the public API. Audit on 2026-01-26 found the codebase already compliant, so the work was documentation.

nodes.label: RemoteAgent::hangUp() Casing Quirk
nodes.rationale: RemoteAgent::hangUp() keeps a capital U for historical/backward-compatibility reasons; harmless because PHP method names are case-insensitive. Renaming to hangup() is suggested for v3.0.

nodes.label: *Response() DTO Method Variant Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every raw-string method has a sibling with a Response suffix (updateFields()->updateFieldsResponse()) returning a VicidialResponse DTO, so structured responses are opt-in and original methods stay backward compatible.

nodes.label: TransporterException (legacy name used in older docs)
nodes.norm_label: transporterexception (legacy name used in older docs)

nodes.label: Retry on response status code, not only on thrown exceptions
nodes.norm_label: retry on response status code, not only on thrown exceptions
nodes.rationale: HttpTransporter::sendRequest() catches ClientExceptionInterface, but a PSR-18 client that returns 5xx without throwing is never retried; only Guzzle's ClientException carries a response.

nodes.label: TransportException Autoload Fix
nodes.rationale: The class was defined in TransporterException.php, so PSR-4 autoloading could not find VicidialApi\Exceptions\TransportException and any network error crashed with 'Class not found'. Moved to TransportException.php; TransporterException kept as deprecated alias.

nodes.label: TransportException moved to its own file (PSR-4 autoload fix)
nodes.norm_label: transportexception moved to its own file (psr-4 autoload fix)
nodes.rationale: Critical: the class lived in TransporterException.php so PSR-4 could not autoload it and every network error died with 'Class TransportException not found' instead of the documented exception, making retry/timeout unusable in production. Old name kept as a deprecated class_alias; regression test added.

nodes.label: Deprecated Exception Aliases (removal in v3.0)
nodes.rationale: ErrorException->ApiErrorException, UnserializableResponse->InvalidResponseException, InvalidArgumentException->ConfigurationException, TransporterException->TransportException. Old classes now extend the new ones (or are aliases) so existing catch blocks keep working until v3.0.

nodes.label: 100% Backward Compatible / Opt-in Feature Policy
nodes.rationale: Every v2.0 addition is opt-in with defaults preserving v1.x behaviour: legacy factories still work, retries disabled unless RetryConfig provided, logging only when a logger is passed, Response DTOs are separate methods. No breaking changes in 2.0.

nodes.label: Configuration Object Pattern (VicidialConfig + VicidialClient)
nodes.rationale: Single VicidialConfig object with PHP 8 named parameters (host, user, pass, protocol, verifyTls, timeout, urlEncodeDefault, userAgent, source, later connectTimeout/retryConfig/logger) consumed by VicidialClient::make(). Rationale: explicit self-documenting config, IDE type safety, extensible without breaking signatures, sensible defaults, built-in validation (protocol http/https, timeout > 0), easier to mock in tests.

nodes.label: Legacy Factory Method Deprecation
nodes.rationale: VicidialApi::create(), ::createWithBasicAuth(), ::factory() remain functional but deprecated. Timeline: v2.0 introduce config approach, v2.x both supported, v3.0 legacy may be removed. Gradual migration at the user's pace.

nodes.label: Standard vs HTTP Basic Authentication Modes
nodes.norm_label: standard vs http basic authentication modes
nodes.rationale: Standard mode sends API user/pass as query params (Agent and Admin APIs). Basic Auth mode (VicidialConfig::createWithBasicAuth / VicidialApi::createWithBasicAuth) adds HTTP Basic credentials, required for Remote Agent operations.

nodes.label: update_did (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates Inbound DID information in the vicidial_inbound_dids table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + Modify DIDs. Special characters in did_pattern must be URL encoded ('+' as %2B).

nodes.label: audio_playback (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Basic play/pause/resume/stop/restart audio in agent session. PAUSE/RESUME/RESTART only work on Asterisk 1.8+; on older versions RESTART is replicated with PLAY and dial_override=Y.

nodes.label: force_fronter_audio_stop (Agent API)

nodes.label: force_fronter_leave_3way (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends a command to fronter agent to leave the 3-way call.

nodes.label: refresh_panel (Agent API)

nodes.label: switch_lead (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: For inbound calls, switches lead_id of live inbound call on agent screen. Either lead_id or vendor_lead_code required; lead_id overrides. Works like the SELECT function of the agent LEAD SEARCH feature.

nodes.rationale: No token, session or OAuth: credentials travel in the query string on every call, so HTTPS (protocol: 'https' in VicidialConfig) is recommended. source is a free-text label (max 20 chars) that appears in VICIdial logs.

nodes.label: Non-Agent API endpoint /vicidial/non_agent_api.php
nodes.rationale: Acts on the system: leads, lists, campaigns, users, phones, DIDs, DNC, hopper, reports. Wrapped by VicidialApi\Resources\Admin. Called 'Admin' in the wrapper.

nodes.label: user_level permissions
nodes.rationale: Checked per function against the vicidial_users row: user_level 7 for reporting, 8 for anything that modifies the system, 9 for call_dispo_report; plus feature flags (View Reports, Modify Leads, Modify Users, Modify Campaigns, AGC Admin Access, Delete From DNC Lists, Modify Remote Agents, Agent API Access since 2025-09), user-group restrictions and an optional IP allow-list.

nodes.label: Non-Agent API reference (docs/admin.md)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the official NON-AGENT_API.txt (header says Updated 2021-03-03) one section per function; later sections show the wrapper method and its ...Response() variant.

nodes.label: Agent API reference (docs/agent.md)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the official AGENT_API.txt text, one section per function, each followed by the wrapper call that implements it.

nodes.label: Permission denial returns HTTP 200 with ERROR body
nodes.norm_label: permission denial returns http 200 with error body
nodes.rationale: A denied call does not return HTTP 401/403; it returns 200 with 'ERROR: <function> USER DOES NOT HAVE PERMISSION ...'. This is why the wrapper must inspect the body prefix instead of relying on HTTP status codes.

nodes.label: Plain HTTP GET + plain-text API (not REST/JSON)
nodes.norm_label: plain http get + plain-text api (not rest/json)
nodes.rationale: VICIdial exposes two plain HTTP endpoints: each call is a GET with query parameters and the body is plain text. This shapes the whole wrapper: query-string auth, prefix-based status detection and text parsing.

nodes.label: Scheduled job diffing official docs against coverage tests
nodes.norm_label: scheduled job diffing official docs against coverage tests
nodes.rationale: The official docs change a few times a year (NON-AGENT_API.txt updated 2026-09-25); open an issue when a new function appears.

nodes.label: Fixture-driven contract tests from the official example responses
nodes.norm_label: fixture-driven contract tests from the official example responses
nodes.rationale: Validates parsing against real shapes; the fixtures file already exists, extend it per function.

nodes.label: 15 Non-Agent + 3 Agent functions added with ...Response() variants
nodes.norm_label: 15 non-agent + 3 agent functions added with ...response() variants
nodes.rationale: Coverage-guard tests now enforce parity with the official function index.

nodes.label: No CI: composer test (pint, rector, phpstan max, phpunit) runs nowhere
nodes.norm_label: no ci: composer test (pint, rector, phpstan max, phpunit) runs nowhere

nodes.label: Coverage-guard tests (AdminCoverageTest / AgentCoverageTest)
nodes.rationale: tests/Resources/AdminCoverageTest.php and AgentCoverageTest.php fail if a documented VICIdial function has no wrapper method, so the wrapper covers every function in both official documents.

nodes.label: Remote agent script /vicidial/vdremote.php
nodes.rationale: Not part of the public API docs; toggles remote agents (external phones without an agent screen) and usually needs HTTP Basic Auth. Exposed as VicidialApi\Resources\RemoteAgent.

nodes.label: Authentication header tests (Bearer vs Basic Auth)
nodes.norm_label: authentication header tests (bearer vs basic auth)

nodes.label: Contract tests (HttpTransporterTest, RetryBehaviorTest) with PSR-18 mock
nodes.norm_label: contract tests (httptransportertest, retrybehaviortest) with psr-18 mock

nodes.label: Fixtures: VicidialResponses.php built from official doc responses
nodes.norm_label: fixtures: vicidialresponses.php built from official doc responses

nodes.label: Future: Guzzle integration test for 5xx retry, network error and timeout simulation
nodes.norm_label: future: guzzle integration test for 5xx retry, network error and timeout simulation

nodes.label: Unit tests for ValueObjects (BaseUri, QueryParams, Parameter, Headers, Payload)
nodes.norm_label: unit tests for valueobjects (baseuri, queryparams, parameter, headers, payload)

nodes.label: Test suite summary (unit + contract tests without a live VICIdial)
nodes.norm_label: test suite summary (unit + contract tests without a live vicidial)

nodes.label: Deterministic tests without a live VICIdial instance
nodes.norm_label: deterministic tests without a live vicidial instance
nodes.rationale: No external dependencies, fast, deterministic via fixtures, CI/CD ready, and the tests double as usage documentation; full 5xx retry behavior is deferred because it needs Guzzle's ClientException or network simulation.

nodes.label: Transport Contract Tests
nodes.rationale: HttpTransporterTest and RetryBehaviorTest exercise the real HttpTransporter against MockPsrClient: GET query params, POST JSON body, URL encoding, header injection, retry config acceptance.

nodes.label: PSR-18 Clients Do Not Throw on HTTP Error Status
nodes.norm_label: psr-18 clients do not throw on http error status
nodes.rationale: Root cause of RetryBehaviorTest::test_does_not_retry_when_disabled failing: HttpTransporter's retry logic only activates when Guzzle's ClientException is thrown, but a pure PSR-18 client returns a 5xx Response without throwing, so no retry and no exception. Decision: keep RetryBehaviorTest focused on configuration and success flow, and test 5xx retry with a Guzzle-based client in integration tests.

nodes.label: VicidialApi::createWithBasicAuth() Made Static
nodes.rationale: README documented a static call but the method was an instance method, failing with 'Non-static method cannot be called statically'.

nodes.label: ApiErrorException
nodes.rationale: Thrown when VICIdial returns a body starting with 'ERROR:'; exposes getRawResponse().

nodes.label: AuthenticationException
nodes.rationale: Invalid credentials, missing API user configuration, unauthorized access. Treated as permanent.

nodes.label: ConfigurationException
nodes.rationale: Invalid host URL, protocol not http/https, invalid timeouts, connect timeout greater than request timeout.

nodes.label: InvalidResponseException
nodes.rationale: Unexpected format, missing fields, corrupted or empty body; exposes getRawResponse(). Possible API version mismatch.

nodes.label: Migration from v1.x strpos('ERROR:') parsing
nodes.rationale: v1.x required manual strpos checks on the returned string; v2.0+ gives typed exceptions plus ok()/get() on the response.

nodes.label: RetryException
nodes.rationale: All retry attempts exhausted; exposes getAttemptsMade().

nodes.label: UnserializableResponse (deprecated)
nodes.rationale: JSON parsing errors; subclass of InvalidResponseException kept for compatibility.

nodes.label: Agent::dial()/updateFields() throw \Exception instead of InvalidArgumentException
nodes.rationale: Callers cannot distinguish programmer errors from transport errors.

nodes.label: Structured exception hierarchy rooted at VicidialException
nodes.norm_label: structured exception hierarchy rooted at vicidialexception
nodes.rationale: One base class lets callers catch every wrapper error with a single catch block while still allowing per-type handling; deprecated names are kept as subclasses for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Log raw responses for debugging
nodes.rationale: ApiErrorException and InvalidResponseException carry getRawResponse() so the VICIdial body can be logged for debugging API parameters or version mismatches.

nodes.label: Transient vs permanent error classification
nodes.rationale: TransportException and RetryException are transient (queue for retry / release job); AuthenticationException and ConfigurationException are permanent (fix config, notify admin). This drives the queue-job pattern that releases on transient errors and fails on anything else.

nodes.label: Response (internal transporter value object, ValueObjects\Transporter\Response)
nodes.rationale: Lower-level generic response used by the transporter; from(array|string) and data().

nodes.label: HttpTransporter Retry Loop
nodes.rationale: sendRequest(): attempt -> on failure check retryable via shouldRetryStatusCode()/network exception -> compute backoff delay -> sleep -> retry up to maxAttempts -> log every attempt; throws RetryException (chaining TransportException) when exhausted.

nodes.label: Structured Exception Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: VicidialException base with AuthenticationException, TransportException (wraps PSR-18 ClientExceptionInterface, original via getPrevious()), ApiErrorException (getRawResponse()), InvalidResponseException (getRawResponse()), ConfigurationException, RetryException (getAttemptsMade()). Rationale: type-safe, catch-the-base handling; raw responses and attempt counts aid debugging; integrates with logging/monitoring.

nodes.label: agent_campaigns (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Looks up allowed campaigns/in-groups for a specific user. Requires API user_level/permission: 7.

nodes.label: agent_ingroup_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Shows in-group and outbound auto-dial info for logged-in agent. Requires API user_level/permission: 7.

nodes.label: campaigns_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Displays information about all campaigns in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 7.

nodes.label: user_details (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Display information about one user.

nodes.label: ok()/failed()/status() success detection
nodes.rationale: ok() is true when status is 'success' or the raw body starts with 'SUCCESS:'; status() is success, error or notice; failed() is the inverse of ok().

nodes.label: Pipe-delimited list rows (field_N keys)
nodes.rationale: Used by list exports and real-time status (agent_status, campaigns_list, agent_campaigns); parsed as field_0, field_1, ...

nodes.label: Status detection rules (SUCCESS / ERROR / NOTICE / informational)
nodes.norm_label: status detection rules (success / error / notice / informational)
nodes.rationale: SUCCESS: starts with SUCCESS: or is informational output with no ERROR; ERROR: starts with or contains ERROR; NOTICE: starts with NOTICE:.

nodes.label: VicidialResponse::determineStatus() treats any body without ERROR as success
nodes.norm_label: vicidialresponse::determinestatus() treats any body without error as success
nodes.rationale: An empty body or an HTML login page from a misconfigured proxy reads as success; treat empty bodies and text/html as errors.

nodes.label: Raw data output (success inferred by output)
nodes.norm_label: raw data output (success inferred by output)
nodes.rationale: Query functions (agent_status, campaigns_list, lead_all_info, user_details, most reports) print rows directly with no SUCCESS prefix, so ok() must be read as 'no ERROR: seen', not 'rows were found'.

nodes.label: SUCCESS/ERROR/NOTICE response prefix
nodes.rationale: Status-line shape for commands: 'SUCCESS: <function> <message> - <pipe|delimited|data>', 'ERROR: ...' or 'NOTICE: ...' (partial or non-blocking condition).

nodes.label: VicidialResponseTest: parsing for all VICIdial formats
nodes.norm_label: vicidialresponsetest: parsing for all vicidial formats

nodes.label: Response DTOs (VicidialResponse)
nodes.rationale: Structured response object with ok(), failed(), get(), asArray(), asText(), toJson() and optional request ID; auto-parses JSON, key-value and pipe-delimited Vicidial formats so callers stop regex/string parsing. Opt-in via *Response() methods.

nodes.label: version (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Shows version and build of the API, along with the date/time and timezone.

nodes.label: version (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Shows version and build of the API, along with the date/time.

nodes.label: webserver (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Display webserver information, very useful for load balanced setups.

nodes.label: Multi-line key: value text (webserver)
nodes.rationale: Keys such as set.timezone, abbr.timezone, php version are accessed directly by name.

nodes.label: VERSION format: KEY: value pairs separated by pipes
nodes.norm_label: version format: key: value pairs separated by pipes
nodes.rationale: Parsed into lowercase keys version, build, date, epoch.

nodes.label: vicidial:ping console command calling version on both endpoints
nodes.norm_label: vicidial:ping console command calling version on both endpoints

nodes.label: Key-value text output (version/webserver)
nodes.rationale: Third response shape: 'VERSION: 2.14-890a|BUILD: ...|DATE: ...|EPOCH: ...' used by version and webserver.

nodes.label: add_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a list to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: update_alt_url (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates/adds/displays alternate dispo call url entries for a campaign. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify campaigns.

nodes.label: update_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates list information in the vicidial_lists table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: update_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates or deletes a phone entry already in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access.

nodes.label: update_presets (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates/adds/displays/deletes campaign preset entries. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify campaigns.

nodes.label: --BLANK-- clear-field sentinel
nodes.rationale: The literal --BLANK-- clears a field in update functions; multi-value inputs are comma separated, status lists space separated.

nodes.label: Value Object Unit Tests
nodes.rationale: BaseUriTest (URL building), QueryParamsTest, ParameterTest (type conversion), HeadersTest (Bearer/Basic auth), PayloadTest (request construction), plus VicidialResponse parsing tests.

nodes.label: Offline Deterministic Test Strategy
nodes.rationale: Tests use recorded Vicidial response fixtures (VicidialResponses) and a PSR-18 MockPsrClient that queues responses and captures requests, so the whole suite runs without a Vicidial server in ~50ms, deterministically, in any CI environment; tests double as living documentation.

nodes.label: Full Vicidial Agent and Non-Agent API Parity
nodes.norm_label: full vicidial agent and non-agent api parity
nodes.rationale: All 31 Agent API functions (AGENT_API.txt 2025-08-30) and 61 Non-Agent functions (NON-AGENT_API.txt 2026-09-25) have wrapper methods plus ...Response() DTO variants; Unreleased added soundsList, batchUpdateLead, leadSearch, hopperBulkInsert, stereoRecording, sendNotification, refreshPanel and more.

nodes.label: add_did (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds new Inbound DID entries to the system in the vicidial_inbound_dids table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + Modify DIDs.

nodes.label: copy_did (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds new Inbound DID entries copied from an existing DID entry. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + Modify DIDs.

nodes.label: add_dnc_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds phone number to a DNC list in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: delete_dnc_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Removes phone number from a DNC list in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists + Delete From DNC Lists.

nodes.label: Agent::switchLead() Sends lead_id
nodes.rationale: switchLead sent the lead as 'value', which the Agent API ignores (it reads lead_id or vendor_lead_code), so it always failed with 'switch_lead not valid'.

nodes.label: add_fpg_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds phone number to a Filter Phone Group in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: delete_fpg_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Removes phone number from a Filter Phone Group in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: add_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a phone to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access.

nodes.label: copy_phone (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Copies a phone in the system.

nodes.label: add_user (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a user to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify users.

nodes.label: copy_user (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Copies an existing user in the system to a new user ID and name. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify users.

nodes.label: st_get_agent_active_lead (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Looks up active lead info for an agent and outputs lead information.

nodes.label: st_login_log (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Looks up vicidial_users.custom_three and logs event from CRM.

nodes.label: add_group_alias (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds group alias to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access.

nodes.label: add_phone_alias (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds a phone alias entry to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access.

nodes.label: blind_monitor (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Calls user-defined phone and places them in session as blind monitor. Requires API user_level/permission: 7. stage is MONITOR, BARGE or HIJACK (default MONITOR).

nodes.label: call_status_stats (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Report on number of calls made by campaign and ingroup, with hourly and status breakdowns. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + view reports.

nodes.label: check_phone_number (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Allows you to check if a phone number is valid and dialable. Requires API user_level/permission: 8.

nodes.label: agent_ingroup_availability (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Shows a total count of agents available to take calls in selected ingroups. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + View Reports. stage=json returns JSON, otherwise comma-delimited output.

nodes.label: agent_stats_export (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Exports agent activity statistics. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: agent_status (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Real-time status of one agent user. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: batch_update_lead (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates multiple leads in vicidial_list with a single set of field values. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify_leads=1. Limited field options; records defaults to 100 most recently created leads.

nodes.label: callid_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Information about a call based upon the caller_code or call ID. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: ccc_lead_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs lead data for cross-cluster-communication call. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: did_log_export (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Exports all calls inbound to a DID for one day. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: hopper_bulk_insert (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Adds group of lead_ids to the vicidial_hopper table. Requires API user_level/permission: modify_campaigns=1.

nodes.label: hopper_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Displays information about leads in the hopper for a campaign. Requires API user_level/permission: 7.

nodes.label: in_group_status (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Real-time status of one or more in groups. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: lead_all_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs all lead data for a lead (optionally including custom fields). Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports + modify_leads 1-5.

nodes.label: lead_callback_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs scheduled callback data for a specific lead. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: lead_search (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Searches for leads in the vicidial_list table by phone numbers. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports + modify_leads 1-5. records defaults to 1000, most recently inserted leads first.

nodes.label: lead_status_search (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Displays all field values of all leads that match the status and call date. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + modify leads.

nodes.label: list_custom_fields (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Shows the custom data fields that are in a list, or all lists. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: list_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Summary information about a list. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify lists.

nodes.label: logged_in_agents (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: List of agents that are logged in to the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: phone_number_log (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Exports list of calls placed to one or more phone numbers. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: recording_lookup (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Looks up recordings based upon user and date or lead_id. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: sounds_list (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Outputs a list of audio files from the audio store. Requires API user_level/permission: 7. format may be tab, link or selectframe; stage sorts by date, size or name. Listed twice in the official doc.

nodes.label: update_lead (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates lead information in the vicidial_list and custom_ tables. Requires API user_level/permission: modify_leads=1. Lookup by lead_id, vendor_lead_code or phone_number (search_method); records caps how many matches are updated (default 1, most recently loaded); insert_if_not_found=Y turns it into an upsert; --BLANK-- clears a field.

nodes.label: update_log_entry (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates the status of a vicidial_log or vicidial_closer_log entry. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify leads.

nodes.label: user_group_status (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Real-time status of one or more user groups. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + view reports.

nodes.label: recording (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends a recording start/stop signal or status of agent recording. START allows multiple concurrent recordings; STOP stops all; optional stage suffix is appended to the filename, truncated at 14 chars.

nodes.label: stereo_recording (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Send a start or stop stereo agent recording signal to agent screen.

nodes.label: Parse stage=csv|tab|json with header=YES into rows keyed by header
nodes.norm_label: parse stage=csv|tab|json with header=yes into rows keyed by header
nodes.rationale: Today everything multi-line falls into the key: value branch or 'result'.

nodes.label: Hard limits of the VICIdial API
nodes.norm_label: hard limits of the vicidial api
nodes.rationale: 100,000 rows for recording_lookup/did_log_export/phone_number_log; 10,000,000 records scanned for agent_stats_export/user_group_status/in_group_status/update_log_entry; 2,000 rows lead_status_search; 1,000 lead_search; 100 batch_update_lead; 1,000 lead ids hopper_bulk_insert; source 20 chars; pause_code and ra_call_control status 6 chars; recording stage suffix 14 chars. No rate limit is documented, but heavy report pulls hurt the database.

nodes.label: Push a lead and queue it in the hopper
nodes.norm_label: push a lead and queue it in the hopper
nodes.rationale: addLeadResponse then read lead_id from data_1 of 'SUCCESS: add_lead LEAD HAS BEEN ADDED - phone|list|lead_id|...' and pass it to hopperBulkInsert.

nodes.label: records row cap parameter
nodes.rationale: Caps result rows: lead_search defaults to 1000, batch_update_lead to 100.

nodes.label: stage output format
nodes.rationale: stage selects pipe (default), csv, tab, json, sometimes newline for reporting functions; moh_list, vm_list and sounds_list use format=selectframe instead.

nodes.label: Wallboard data pulls
nodes.rationale: agentInGroupAvailability(stage=json), inGroupStatus(stage=csv, header=YES), loggedInAgents(stage=csv, header=YES).

nodes.label: lead_dearchive (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Moves a lead from the archive to active leads table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify leads.

nodes.label: lead_field_info (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Pulls the value of one field of a lead. Requires API user_level/permission: 7 + modify leads.

nodes.label: server_refresh (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Forces a conf file refresh on all telco servers in the cluster. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access. stage must be 'REFRESH'.

nodes.label: update_campaign (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates campaign information in the vicidial_campaigns table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify campaigns.

nodes.label: update_cid_group_entry (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates CID Group entries in the vicidial_campaign_cid_areacodes table. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + Modify Campaigns. stage is UPDATE, ADD, DELETE or INFO.

nodes.label: update_phone_alias (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates or deletes a phone alias entry already in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + ast admin access.

nodes.label: update_user (Non-Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Updates or deletes a user entry already in the system. Requires API user_level/permission: 8 + modify users.

nodes.label: call_agent (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Send a call to connect the agent to their session. Not designed to work with on-hook agents.

nodes.label: calls_in_queue_count (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Display a count of the calls waiting in queue for the specific agent.

nodes.label: change_ingroups (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Changes the selected in-groups for a logged-in agent. API user must have vicidial_users.change_agent_campaign = 1; once changed this way the agent must log out/in to pick in-groups themselves.

nodes.label: preview_dial_action (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends SKIP, DIALONLY, ALTDIAL, ADR3DIAL or FINISH during preview or manual alt dial.

nodes.label: send_dtmf (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends dtmf signal string to agent's session.

nodes.label: send_notification (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sends text alerts and/or confetti effects to agent interface. If recipient_type is omitted the recipient value is matched in priority order USER, USER_GROUP, CAMPAIGN; disabled unless Agent API Notifications are enabled system-wide.

nodes.label: set_timer_action (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Sets timer action for the current call the agent is on.

nodes.label: vm_message (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Set a custom voicemail message played when agent clicks the VM button. Requires campaign 'Answering Machine Message' set to LTTagent; 'AM Message Wildcards' and 'VM Message Groups' can override it.

nodes.label: webphone_url (Agent API)
nodes.rationale: Display or launch the webphone url for the current agent's session.

nodes.label: ConfigurationException Replaces Generic InvalidArgumentException
nodes.rationale: VicidialConfig, RetryConfig, Parameter and Factory now throw ConfigurationException instead of \InvalidArgumentException / \RuntimeException; RetryConfigTest and VicidialConfigTest updated accordingly.

nodes.label: RetryConfig Value Object Design
nodes.rationale: Immutable value object with factory presets disabled()/default()/custom(); constructor validation gives compile-time-like safety; options enabled, maxAttempts, initialDelayMs, maxDelayMs, multiplier, retryOn5xx, retryOnNetworkErrors, retryOn429.

both encode the mapping from Vicidial API function names to wrapper methods; one documents it, the other enforces completeness
both protect a recovering server from repeated load; no structural link
both keep deprecated symbols working as aliases/wrappers with removal scheduled for v3.0
